core.headline: Detached house with indoor pool, 2.1 acres, triple garage
core.summary: Set within 2.1 acres in the Kent Downs National Landscape, a detached house with indoor swimming pool, triple garage and three reception rooms. Guide Price £1,250,000 freehold.
core.listing:
Hollybank stands within 2.1 acres on Pilgrims Way, Wrotham, within the Kent Downs National Landscape and the Metropolitan Green Belt. The plot is accessed by a driveway leading to a triple garage.

The detached house was built in 1987 and provides four bedrooms, three bathrooms and three reception rooms. The principal rooms include a drawing room, dining room and sitting room.

A kitchen opens to family space. The ground floor also accommodates an indoor swimming pool.

The principal bedroom is on the first floor. Three further bedrooms are served by two additional bathrooms.

The grounds extend to approximately 2.1 acres.

Wrotham lies within the Kent Downs National Landscape. The M20 and M26 motorways provide access to the wider region.

Guide Price £1,250,000. Tenure: freehold. Council Tax: Band G (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). EPC rating: D. Construction: standard. Electricity: mains. Water: mains (metered). Sewerage: mains. Heating: oil-fired central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. Parking: driveway. The property is within the Kent Downs National Landscape and the Metropolitan Green Belt. Building safety, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known.
